unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 (github.com/usainbluntmx/sekisho/issues/1): "A feeless (XNO) rail for the SplitVault". Argued in its own vault terms: SplitVault splits 1.5% treasury / 98.5% merchant on-chain -> on Nano each leg pays its own account, two public blocks, no vault contract, no 1.5% route, no batched distribute(); no Kanjo facilitator and no gas to orchestrate (seller holds no gas token). The sdk/ x402 paid-MCP story maps one-to-one. Carried nano-invoice + extract.paypercall.dev. Verified open under dhyabi2, created 2026-10-21.
